meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一段文字或笔记做成无人出镜的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿,想让没有实拍画面的内容变成能发布的视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn written text or notes into an explainer video with no on-camera presenter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have written content and want a publishable video without filming anything.

howto.what: 它把一段文字——文章、笔记、主题或简报——做成无真人出镜的解说视频;没有网站或素材可录制,每个场景的画面(排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化等)都由它现造。
howto.when: 当你要把一段文字做成主题讲解、概念拆解、教程等解说视频,且没有网站或素材可录制时接管。意图不明确时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成一段无真人出镜的解说视频
say.note: 会先建项目、写简要,再逐步生成并渲染

say.text: 用这份笔记做一期概念拆解视频,画面按场景现造
say.note: 画面逐个场景生成,不需要素材录制

say.text: 先别按原文顺序,把这段文字重排成 60 秒解说视频
say.note: 它会重排、合并或省略段落,再请你确认分镜

howto.what_en: It turns a body of text — an article, notes, a topic, or a brief — into a faceless explainer video: no site or footage is captured, and each scene's visuals (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz) are invented.
howto.when_en: Turns text into a topic explainer, concept breakdown, or how-to video when there is no site or footage to capture. Unclear intent routes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video
say_en.note: Sets up project and brief first, then builds step by step.

say_en.text: Use these notes to make a concept breakdown video; invent the visuals per scene
say_en.note: Visuals are invented per scene, frame by frame.

say_en.text: Don't follow the text's paragraph order; reorder it into a 60-second explainer
say_en.note: It reorders, merges or omits text, then asks for approval.
